occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985): One caregiver did not have affidavit 2985 or 2912 on file.

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A Background check result was found to be noncompliant with Minimum Standards.
